arxiv-2211-09987.title: Simulating the charging of isolated free-falling masses from TeV to eV energies: detailed comparison with LISA Pathfinder results
arxiv-2211-09987.creator: P. J. Wass, T. J. Sumner, H. M. Araújo, D. Hollington
arxiv-2211-09987.description: Abstract A model is presented that explains the charging rate of the LISA Pathfinder test masses by the interplanetary cosmic ray environment. The model incorporates particle-tracking from TeV to eV energies using a combination of G eant 4 and a custom low-energy particle generation and tracking code.

arxiv-2302-00376.title: Boundary states and Non-Abelian Casimir effect in lattice Yang-Mills theory
arxiv-2302-00376.creator: Maxim N. Chernodub, Vladimir A. Goy, Alexander V. Molochkov, Alexey S. Tanashkin
arxiv-2302-00376.description: Abstract Using first-principle numerical simulations, we investigate the Casimir effect in zero-temperature SU(3) lattice gauge theory in 3+1 spacetime dimensions. The Casimir interaction between perfect chromometallic mirrors reveals the presence of a new gluonic state with the mass m gt = 1.0 ​ ( 1 ) ​ σ = 0.49 ​ ( 5 ) ​ GeV = 0.

arxiv-2304-04389.description: Abstract . Knowledge graphs (KGs) store rich facts about the real world. In this paper, we study KG alignment, which aims to find alignment between not only entities but also relations and classes in different KGs. arxiv-2310-03299.title: Dynamical Architectures of S-type Transiting Planets in Binaries I: Target Selection using Hipparcos and Gaia proper motion anomalies Also referred to as Hipparcos and Gaia astrometric accelerations Facilities: Kepler , TESS , Gaia , Hipparcos , Keck:10m orvara ( Brandt et al. 2021 ) ,
arxiv-2310-03299.creator: Jingwen Zhang (张婧雯), Lauren M. Weiss, Daniel Huber, Eric L. N. Jensen, Timothy D. Brandt, Karen Collins, Dennis M. Conti, Howard Isaacson, Pablo Lewin, Guiseppi Marino, Bob Massey, Felipe Murgas, Enric Palle, Don J. Radford, Howard M. Relles, Gregor Srdoc, Chris Stockdale, Thiam-Guan Tan, Gavin Wang
arxiv-2310-03299.description: Abstract The effect of stellar multiplicity on planetary architecture and orbital dynamics provides an important context for exoplanet demographics. We present a volume-limited catalog up to 300 pc of 66 stars hosting planets and planet candidates from Kepler , K2 and TESS with significant Hipparcos-Gaia proper motion anomalies, which indicates the presence of companions.

arxiv-2312-05242.title: The infinite Fibonacci cube and its generalizations
arxiv-2312-05242.creator: Hiep Trinh and Trevor M. Wilson
arxiv-2312-05242.description: Abstract The Fibonacci cube Γ n \Gamma_{n} is is the graph whose vertices are independent subsets of the path graph of length n n , where two such vertices are considered adjacent if they differ by the addition or removal of a single element.

arxiv-2408-01024.title: Semantic Skill Grounding for Embodied Instruction-Following in Cross-Domain Environments
arxiv-2408-01024.creator: Sangwoo Shin, Seunghyun Kim, Youngsoo Jang, Moontae Lee, Honguk Woo, Department of Computer Science, Engineering, Sungkyunkwan University, LG AI Research, University of Illinois Chicago
arxiv-2408-01024.description: Abstract In embodied instruction-following (EIF), the integration of pretrained language models (LMs) as task planners emerges as a significant branch, where tasks are planned at the skill level by prompting LMs with pretrained skills and user instructions. However, grounding these pretrained skills in different domains remains challenging due to their intricate entanglement with the domain-specific knowledge.

arxiv-2502-21177.title: Problems on handlebody groups
arxiv-2502-21177.creator: Naomi Andrew, Sebastian Hensel, Sam Hughes, Richard D. Wade
arxiv-2502-21177.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Naomi Andrew, Sebastian Hensel, Sam Hughes, Richard D. Wade. We survey a number of constructions and open problems related to the handlebody group, with a focus on recent trends in geometric group theory, (co)homological properties, and its relationship to outer automorphism groups of free groups. We also briefly describe how the cheap α \alpha -rebuilding property of Abert, Bergeron, Fraczyk, and Gaboriau can be applied using the disc complex to deduce results about the homology growth of the handlebody group.

arxiv-2512-05806.title: Global stability of vehicle-with-driver dynamics via Sum-of-Squares programming
arxiv-2512-05806.creator: Martino Gulisano and Marco Gabiccini
arxiv-2512-05806.description: Abstract This work estimates safe invariant subsets of the Region of Attraction (ROA) for a seven-state vehicle-with-driver system, capturing both asymptotic stability and the influence of state-safety bounds along the system trajectory. Safe sets are computed by optimizing Lyapunov functions through an original iterative Sum-of-Squares (SOS) procedure.

pmc-10618972.title: Repeated methamphetamine exposure decreases plasma brain-derived neurotrophic factor levels in rhesus monkeys
pmc-10618972.creator: Wenlei Zhang, Jiahui Zhou, Hang Su, Xiaocheng Zhang, Weichen Song, Zijing Wang, Chengjie Tang, Kadir Uludağ, Min Zhao, Zhi-Qi Xiong, Rongwei Zhai, Haifeng Jiang
pmc-10618972.description: BackgroundBrain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) is known to prevent methamphetamine (METH)-induced neurotoxicity and plays a role in various stages of METH addiction. However, there is a lack of research with longitudinal design on changes in plasma BDNF levels in active METH-dependent individuals.AimsThe aim of the study was to investigate changes in BDNF levels during METH self-administration in monkeys.

pmc-10831764.title: Parálisis bilateral de las cuerdas vocales con obstrucción aguda de la vía aérea y traqueotomía urgente en una paciente con ictus vertebrobasilar agudo
pmc-10831764.creator: Carolina Díaz-Pérez, Santiago Trillo, Carlos Hervás, Florentino Nombela, José Vivancos
pmc-10831764.description: Introducción.El ictus vertebrobasilar puede suponer un reto diagnóstico. La parálisis bilateral de las cuerdas vocales como manifestación de ictus agudo es muy rara, pero potencialmente mortal, por la posibilidad de obstrucción aguda de la vía aérea. No hay casos descritos de parálisis bilateral de las cuerdas vocales como presentación de ictus agudo de etiología neurológica mixta central y periférica.Caso clínico.

pmc-11375625.title: Deciphering the Evolution of Inertial Migration in Serpentine Channels
pmc-11375625.creator: Yong Liu, Jun Zhang, Xiaobo Peng, Sheng Yan
pmc-11375625.description: Serpentine channels coupling inertial and secondary flows enable effective particle focusing and separation, showing great potential in clinical diagnostics and drug screening. However, the nonsteady secondary flows in the serpentine channel make the evolution of inertial migration unclear, hindering the development and application of the serpentine channel.

pmc-11514789.title: Necrotizing fasciitis: treatment concepts & clinical outcomes – an institutional experience
pmc-11514789.creator: Ajay Raveendranadh, S. S. Prasad, Vivek Viswanath
pmc-11514789.description: BackgroundA severe infection of the skin and soft tissues, Necrotizing Fasciitis (NF), spreads quickly along the deep fascia. This study aimed to characterize the clinicopathological features, analyze the implicated bacteria’s antibiotic sensitivity, evaluate surgical management, and assess the diagnostic accuracy of the Laboratory Risk Indicator for Necrotizing Fasciitis (LRINEC) score in Necrotizing Soft Tissue Infection (NST).

pmc-12670932.title: Image dataset of ten durian diseases captured in real-field conditions from a family orchard in Vinh Long, Vietnam
pmc-12670932.creator: Tan Nguyen
pmc-12670932.description: This dataset comprises 5452 images of durian plant parts—including leaves, flowers, branches, stems, and roots—affected by ten common disease classes. The images were captured from one family-owned durian orchard and four nearby orchards in Vinh Long Province, Vietnam. Each class contains approximately 405–427 raw images, photographed using an iPhone 14 under natural field conditions.

pmc-13179852.creator: Shrikant Yadav, Vipul K Srivastava, Harsh V Baranwal, Anup K Pandit, Mantu Yadav, Sangeeta Kumari, Sanjay K Saroj, Satyanam K Bhartiya
pmc-13179852.description: A malignant tumor of adipocytic origin, liposarcoma typically affects the deep soft tissues and retroperitoneum. Although primary mesenteric liposarcoma is uncommon, its association with isolated omental metastasis is a rare entity. A 65-year-old male presented with a painless, progressively enlarging abdominal mass. Imaging revealed multiple fat-attenuated intra-abdominal lesions. Surgical exploration confirmed a large lobulated mesenteric mass and an omental mass.

uslaw-usc-t22-s1741a.title: 22 U.S.C. § 1741a — Special Envoy for Hostage Affairs
uslaw-usc-t22-s1741a.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t22-s1741a.description: United States Code, Title 22 (Foreign Relations And Intercourse); Chapter 23 (Protection Of Citizens Abroad); Subchapter II (Hostage Recovery And Hostage-Taking Accountability). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Establishment There shall be a Special Presidential Envoy for Hostage Affairs, who shall be appointed by the President, by and with the advice and consent of the Senate, and shall report to the Secretary.
